title: US Approves Selling Mexico 11 Black Hawk Helicopters for 20 Billion Pesos
author: SinEmbargo Staff
content:
_This article by SinEmbargo Staff originally appeared in the[November 7, 2026
edition of SinEmbargo](https://www.sinembargo.mx/4900269/eu-aprueba-vender-a-
mexico-11-helicopteros-black-hawk-por-un-monto-de-20-mil-mdp/), an independent
Mexican digital news outlet._

**Mexico City, November 7 (SinEmbargo).—** The **government** of the [**United
States** (**US**)](https://www.sinembargo.mx/tag/estados-unidos/) approved
selling [**Mexico**](https://www.sinembargo.mx/categoria/mexico) more than a
dozen combat **helicopters** and related equipment, for an estimated amount of
**1.075 billion dollars** , equivalent to around 20 billion pesos.

The US [**State Department**](https://www.state.gov/) issued a statement on
Friday reporting that the **Mexican Government** requested the purchase of
**11 UH-60M Black Hawk helicopters,** as well as **equipment** for their
operation, including: 27 T700-GE-701D engines, 27 EAGLE-M+429 inertial
navigation/GPS systems, and 27 AN/ARC-231A RT-1987 very high frequency
(VHF)/ultra high frequency/line-of-sight satellite communication radios.

> US authorities emphasized that the sale of the aircraft to Mexico will not
> affect the US Army’s capability and will support their country’s national
> security and foreign policy objectives “by improving the security of an ally
> that is a force for political stability and economic progress in North
> America.”

According to the terms of the purchase contract for the Black Hawk
helicopters, **at least 15 US government representatives or contractors will
need to travel to Mexico and remain in national territory for an extended
period of time** , in order to support the deployment of the equipment, verify
the systems, and provide training, technical and logistical support.

![UH-60 Black Hawk helicopter](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-
content/uploads/2026/11/02-black-hawk.jpg)Mexico will pay the US around 20
billion pesos for the purchase of 11 Black Hawk helicopters. Photo: US
Department of War

The US government report mentions that the aircraft and equipment acquired by
the country will be used for domestic security work, which “will strengthen
Mexico’s capacity to provide air support to its forces engaged in counter-drug
operations.”

## What Are the Black Hawk Helicopters Mexico Will Buy From the US Like?

According to the statement issued by the US State Department, the prime
contractor in charge of the sale of the Black Hawk helicopters to Mexico will
be Sikorsky, a company owned by Lockheed Martin, the firm responsible for
manufacturing the aircraft.

According to the manufacturer’s information, some of the most notable features
of these helicopters are:

  * Capacity to carry up to 12 fully equipped soldiers.
  * The Black Hawk can be fitted with door and window machine guns, which are operated by the crew.
  * It has an armored floor.
  * It can carry loads of up to 4,080 kilograms.
  * It can be fitted with specialized equipment for rescue or firefighting missions.
  * It has twin engines and the cabin can be reconfigured according to the needs of the mission.

![Soldiers next to a Black Hawk helicopter](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-
content/uploads/2026/11/03-black-hawk-soldiers.jpg)The Black Hawk helicopter
can carry up to 12 soldiers. Photo: US Department of War
